name: You're My Poison
source:
An abnormal detective sets out to solve a mystery and purge a virus, using only cryptic riddles to link the case together.

[From [url=https://stephenw313.itch.io/youre-my-poison]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一個異於常人的偵探著手破解謎案、清除病毒。能將整起案件串聯起來的線索，只有一道道晦澀的謎語。

（來源：[url=https://stephenw313.itch.io/youre-my-poison]itch.io[/url]）
